title: The CDC calls handing back a dropped toy a cause and effect game
summary: The CDC says that picking up a toy a six-month-old drops, and giving it back, helps the baby learn cause and effect.
body: On the six-month page, the CDC suggests a game: when the baby drops a toy on the floor, pick it up and give it back. The page says this game helps him learn cause and effect. The sentence is an activity idea, not a milestone most babies must already show. It is the US CDC's wording for that game.

sources.title: Milestones by 6 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US CDC page, public domain. Updated and reviewed 16 May 2026. Supports the activity sentence that giving back a dropped toy helps the baby learn cause and effect.
